news.title: Deutsche Bank targets Asia crypto custody expansion in 2027 as German launch nears
news.summary: The service will initially support bitcoin, ether and the stablecoins USDC, EURC and EURAU, with the bank managing clients’ wallets and private keys.

news.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
news.summary: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

news.title: The White House's crypto chief departs: State of Crypto
news.summary: Patrick Witt announced his departure from the White House last week.

news.title: Wall Street freaked out Friday, but VIX and bitcoin trades say the fear may fade Monday.
news.summary: Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index, spiked on Friday as stocks dropped. History says Friday panics usually fade on Monday. Seasonality and calm bitcoin markets suggest the same.

news.title: Latvia eyes crypto tax payments in 2027 as parliament overhauls crypto taxation
news.summary: Parliament passed a law taxing crypto withdrawals above deposits rather than individual trades, featuring a one-time declaration mechanism.

news.title: Stablecoin supply stalls, but payments jump 45% as Visa, Mastercard and Stripe connect crypto to cash
news.summary: Analytics firm Allium said stablecoin payments hit $482 billion this year so far, up 45%, as card spending surges and global payment firms add crypto rails.

news.title: Bitcoin’s $100,000 year-end hope divides analysts as inflation clouds outlook
news.summary: Bitwise sees a potential return above $100,000, while LO:TECH expects a narrower trading range as interest-rate uncertainty weighs on the market.

news.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
news.summary: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.

news.title: My wife says we can’t afford to retire. I vetoed her $8,000 trip to Italy. We’re in our 60s and have $4 million. Do I keep working?
news.summary: “I worry about healthcare, long-term care, inflation, a long bear market and living to 95.”

news.title: ‘Some people did everything right’: I lost my home in the Great Recession. I rent in my 50s. Why is that judged as failure?
My sister moved in with our mother, 78, and says she deserves the $925,000 family home. Is she right?
news.summary: “The house is worth $925,000 and mom owns it outright. She also has $480,000 in investments.”

news.title: I’m 64 with two sons, but only one works in the family business. Is it ethical to leave him 70% of the company?
news.summary: “I have some reservations about the long-term stability of my younger son’s marriage.”

news.title: I’m 63 and diagnosed with lymphoma. Should I take my Social Security next year?
news.summary: “My plan is to continue working as long as I’m able to do so and invest my Social Security benefits while I’m still earning a paycheck.”

news.title: These surprising stocks could be some of the biggest drivers of S&P 500 earnings growth
news.summary: Boeing, Meta and EchoStar recorded steep charges and expenses a year ago, which are expected to make this latest quarter’s results look especially strong by comparison.

news.title: Stocks are heading for a high-stakes showdown, as strong earnings collide with rising borrowing costs
news.summary: The idea that the AI trade has been mostly immune to rising bond yields isn’t quite right, one strategist notes.
